title: Same values. Two visual impressions.
description: Both panels show A at 48% and B at 52%. The left axis starts at zero; the right starts at 45%, making the visible bar heights have a ratio of 7 to 3.

title: The same doubling process: curve or line
description: Values 10, 20, 40, 80 bend upward on a linear axis and form a straight line on a base-2 logarithmic axis.

title: One delayed order moves the mean
description: The first row is 18,19,20,20,21,22,22,23,24 with mean and median 21. Replacing 24 by 90 changes the mean to about 28.3 while the median stays at 21.

title: Same center. Very different experiences.
description: Set A contains 19,20,20,20,21. Set B contains 2,3,20,37,38. Both have mean and median 20 but very different ranges.

title: Break 10,000 decisions into four outcomes
description: 90 defects flagged, 10 defects missed, 198 acceptable parts flagged, 9702 acceptable parts passed.

title: Same detection rates. Different alert quality.
description: At 1% defects, 90 true alerts and 198 false alarms give 31.25% precision. At 10% defects, 900 true alerts and 180 false alarms give about 83.3%.

title: The respondents do not match the population
description: The population has 800 commuters and 200 residents. The survey has 100 respondents from each group, overrepresenting residents.

title: Weighting repairs the mix of groups
description: Equal group weights give 50% support. Population weights of 80% and 20% give 32%. This correction depends on within-group representativeness.

title: 同一组数值，两种视觉印象
description: 左右均为 A 期 48%、B 期 52%。左图纵轴从零开始；右图从 45% 开始，使两根柱子的可见长度之比变成 7 比 3。

title: 同样的翻倍过程：弯曲与直线
description: 左图为线性刻度，10、20、40、80 向上弯曲；右图为以 2 为底的对数刻度，形成直线。

title: 一笔订单延迟，均值随之移动
均值和中位数相同，体验仍可不同
把 10,000 次判断拆成四格
description: 有缺陷且被标记 90，缺陷漏检 10，合格误报 198，合格正确放行 9702。

title: 同样的条件率，不同的告警组成
description: 1% 缺陷时，90 个真告警和 198 个误报，精确率 31.25%；10% 缺陷时，900 个真告警和 180 个误报，精确率约 83.3%。

title: 收到的回答，不一定像目标总体
description: 总体 1000 人中，通勤 800、住校 200；回答者 200 人中，两组各 100。住校学生被过度代表。

title: 加权修正的是群体比例
description: 回答者权重各一半，合计支持率 50%；总体权重为通勤 80%、住校 20%，合计支持率 32%。加权有效依赖组内代表性假设。
